rule: Only pick products with CJ product + shipping cost at most one third of the selling price.
Prefer products in stock in a CJ warehouse in the customer's country (faster delivery = fewer refunds).
Never pick branded, trademarked, battery-powered, cosmetic, supplement, medical or children's products.
Every video script starts with a 1-2 second hook that shows the problem, not the product name.
Never invent reviews, fake discounts or fake countdowns. Never claim delivery faster than the CJ estimate.
Anything about refunds, chargebacks, damaged items or angry customers goes to the owner, never answered alone.
